text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to rescind the northbound U-turn prohibition, in effect from 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m., Monday to Friday, on Shaughnessy Boulevard at Glentworth Road/Delverton Place. Removal of the U-turn prohibition will address residents' concerns regarding week day morning peak period access to their homes on the west side of Shaughnessy Boulevard, south of Glentworth Road/Delverton Place, by allowing a feasible traffic movement 24 hours per day, 7 days per week.
North York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the northbound U-turn prohibition, in effect from 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m., Monday to Friday, at Shaughnessy Boulevard and Glentworth Road.
